headerDisplay: Homebridge plugin for the Tesla Wall Connector (Gen 3) local API.
footerDisplay: To use the **Apple Home Energy view** option you need Homebridge 2.3.0 or later with **Matter enabled** on this plugin's child bridge (Bridge Settings → enable Matter), then pair the Matter bridge in the Home app. If Matter isn't available the option is skipped safely and the plugin keeps working over HomeKit/Eve.

ipAddress.title: IP Address
ipAddress.description: Local IP address of the Wall Connector.

pollInterval.title: Poll Interval (ms)
pollInterval.description: How often to poll /api/1/vitals, in milliseconds.

matter.title: Publish over Matter instead of HomeKit (Apple Home Energy view)
matter.description: Publish the charger over Matter as an outlet with live electrical measurements, so it shows watts on its tile and feeds your home energy total. This REPLACES the HomeKit accessory rather than adding to it, so the charger only appears once — switching means re-assigning its room and automations, and the Eve voltage/current/power characteristics are not available. Requires Homebridge 2.3.0+ with Matter enabled on this bridge; falls back to HomeKit if unavailable.

matterEvseBeta.title: BETA: publish as an EV charger (EnergyEvse) instead of an outlet
matterEvseBeta.description: EXPERIMENTAL — has no effect unless the Matter option above is enabled. Publishes using Matter's dedicated EnergyEvse device type (1292) rather than a generic outlet, in the hope that Apple Home renders a proper EV charger tile with charging state. How Apple Home actually handles this is UNVERIFIED — it may show a better tile, an unhelpful one, or none at all. If the device type can't be loaded or the accessory fails to come up, the plugin automatically falls back to the outlet, so you can't be left with no accessory. Turn this off to return to the known-good outlet.
